_comment: The finished builds shown as cards at the top of the landing page (site/index.html), in this order. 'selection' names only the fields that make the build; the rest follow the defaults (the biped's camera is config/assembly.json camera.preset). Each must resolve to a recipe tagged Simulated: tests/test_builds.py fails otherwise. 'picture' is drawn by python -m microduck.buildpics and recorded in reports/builds.json. The address ?build=<id> selects one.

builds.name: Microduck biped
builds.description: A small walking duck: six servos on an Arduino UNO Q, a round display for eyes and wide comb feet.

builds.name: EV3 crank walker
builds.description: A two-motor walker that carries the LEGO EV3 brick and sees with a Pixy2 camera.

builds.name: 51515 hub crank walker
builds.description: The same walker on the LEGO Robot Inventor 51515 hub, driven by its own two motors.

builds.name: Pi Build HAT crank walker
builds.description: A light walker on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with the Build HAT and a Pi camera.

builds.name: Pi two-wheeled rover
builds.description: A quick two-wheeler on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W: TT motors at the back, a skid in front.

builds.name: Microduck-look biped
builds.description: The Microduck's own shape, a quarter larger: fifteen servos on two Arduino UNO Q boards, comb feet.
